title: Italian Fried Pastry Fritter
description: A classic Italian dessert, these fried pastry fritters are typically enjoyed with a side of honey or kissel. For this recipe, we will be using a traditional Italian ingredient, flour, and adding a touch of Moroccan flavors.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and moroccan spices.
Add the honey and jjajeek to the flour mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Heat the fried pastry in a deep frying pan with 2-3 inches of oil.
When the oil is hot, add the dough balls to the pan and fry until golden brown.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve warm with a side of honey.
Optional: Dust the fritters with powdered sugar before serving.
